reviews.title: No free option now
reviews.text: I used to use this app because the interface was very simple and I didn't want a lot of features. Now it's like every other nutrition tracking app with "fancy" features to justify the $40/year subscription and no free option for those who just want to use the calculator.

I hate downloading an app to try for a while before upgrading the plan (longer than a week) only to realize I don’t get that option and need to delete it.

reviews.title: Annoying Bug
reviews.text: You want me to rate your app okay. Adding useless ai features to your app doesn’t make it a better investment , This issue still exists after years >>> Can you guys fix the issue that happens when you try to add a new “food” through nutrition label scanner. reviews.title: App is fine.
reviews.text:
The app has a very visually appealing design, and I like the way it presents tracking and progress, it feels modern and motivating at first glance.
However, the onboarding experience was frustrating. When signing up, the app repeatedly pushed a paid subscription and free trial. Even after pressing the “X,” I was met with prompts like “Not ready to commit?” followed by another discount offer, instead of being taken directly to the free version. It took several attempts just to access the free features, which was unnecessarily time-consuming and off-putting.
Unfortunately, the food logging experience was also difficult. Searching for something simple like “sausage sandwich” returned hundreds of unrelated or overly specific entries, none of which matched a basic meal. Manual entry wasn’t much better, as it required knowing and inputting every ingredient and calorie individually. As someone who works part-time while studying at university, this isn’t practical or efficient to do at the end of a long day.
Overall, while the app looks great and has potential, the aggressive paywall and cumbersome food tracking make it hard to recommend in its current state. I hope future updates focus on improving accessibility, search accuracy, and ease of use.

reviews.title: All the functionality
reviews.text: But such an unintuitive interface. It all seems to work fine but it’s as though the user interface had been designed by an artificial intelligence of a block of wood. I hate the oversized pictures of various foods that take up so much real estate on a small screen. Sort it out and this app would be extremely good.
